prompt: Retrieve Trello card comments, update Trello cards, and perform broader project-management and automation-maintenance operations across task boards, email, chat, and an automation platform.

results.use_case: Retrieve Trello card comments, update Trello cards, and perform broader project-management and automation-maintenance operations across task boards, email, chat, and an automation platform.
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if board identifier unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Find the target board using TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_BOARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER or TRELLO_GET_SEARCH (match by board label, capture board identifier).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Map list names to list identifiers using TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD (avoid requesting embedded cards unless necessary).

[Optional (if card identifiers unknown or you need inventory)] [Prerequisite]: Locate cards using TRELLO_GET_SEARCH or enumerate with TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_CARDS_BY_ID_BOARD (then select target card identifiers).
[Optional (if responses are large/truncated)] [Prerequisite]: Reshape/dedupe candidate cards using COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH (produce a compact write set without emitting identifiers).
[Required (before any write)] [Step]: Re-fetch each target card using TRELLO_GET_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD to confirm current list/fields and obtain explicit user confirmation per move/edit/checklist/comment.

[Optional (if checklist changes approved)] [Step]: Read checklists using TRELLO_GET_CARDS_CHECKLISTS_BY_ID_CARD, then toggle items using TRELLO_UPDATE_CARD_CHECKLIST_ITEM_STATE_BY_IDS (per check-item identifier).

[Required] [Step]: Apply changes using TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_ID_LIST_BY_ID_CARD (move-only) or TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD (move plus field edits), then add a note using TRELLO_ADD_CARDS_ACTIONS_COMMENTS_BY_ID_CARD if requested.
[Fallback (if a write fails or state is stale)] [Fallback]: Re-fetch via TRELLO_GET_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD and retry the intended write once with the latest state.
known_pitfalls: [TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD] Including cards can create very large/truncated payloads; cards may be nested under list objects rather than top-level.
[TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_CARDS_BY_ID_BOARD] Board-wide inventories can be very large; request only needed fields to reduce truncation risk.
[TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD] Updating long text fields (for example descriptions) overwrites the full stored value; re-fetch and merge if you must preserve existing content.
[TRELLO_GET_CARDS_CHECKLISTS_BY_ID_CARD] Checklist items are nested under details/checkItems; updates require the check-item id (not the checklist id).
[TRELLO_ADD_CARDS_ACTIONS_COMMENTS_BY_ID_CARD] Tool responses may not show full comment text; retries are non-idempotent and can create duplicate comments.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Summarize per-list card counts from a board lists payload without emitting identifiers
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import sys,json
j=json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
for r in j.get('results',[]):
  ls=r.get('response',{}).get('data',{}).get('lists',[])
  print([{'list_index':i,'card_count':len(l.get('cards') or [])} for i,l in enumerate(ls)])
```

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Count cards from a board-cards inventory without emitting identifiers
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import sys,json,collections
j=json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
for r in j.get('results',[]):
  cards=r.get('response',{}).get('data',{}).get('cards',[]) or r.get('response',{}).get('data',{}) or []
  c=collections.Counter([(x or {}).get('idList') for x in (cards if isinstance(cards,list) else [])])
  print({'list_count':len([k for k in c if k]),'total_cards':sum(c.values())})
```

TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_BOARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER.description: Retrieves board-level details (not lists/cards) for Trello boards associated with a member ID or username, allowing extensive customization of the returned data.

lists.description: Filters the lists returned for each board. Valid values: 'all', 'closed', 'none', 'open'.

fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for each board. Accepts 'all' or a comma-separated list of field names. Possible field names: 'closed', 'dateLastActivity', 'dateLastView', 'desc', 'descData', 'idOrganization', 'invitations', 'invited', 'labelNames', 'memberships', 'name', 'pinned', 'powerUps', 'prefs', 'shortLink', 'shortUrl', 'starred', 'subscribed', 'url'.

filter.description: Filters the boards returned. Valid values are 'all' or a comma-separated list of: 'closed', 'members', 'open', 'organization', 'pinned', 'public', 'starred', 'unpinned'.

actions.description: Specifies which actions to return for each board. Accepts 'all' or a comma-separated list of action types. Possible action types: 'addAttachmentToCard', 'addChecklistToCard', 'addMemberToBoard', 'addMemberToCard', 'addMemberToOrganization', 'addToOrganizationBoard', 'commentCard', 'convertToCardFromCheckItem', 'copyBoard', 'copyCard', 'copyCommentCard', 'createBoard', 'createCard', 'createList', 'createOrganization', 'deleteAttachmentFromCard', 'deleteBoardInvitation', 'deleteCard', 'deleteOrganizationInvitation', 'disablePowerUp', 'emailCard', 'enablePowerUp', 'makeAdminOfBoard', 'makeNormalMemberOfBoard', 'makeNormalMemberOfOrganization', 'makeObserverOfBoard', 'memberJoinedTrello', 'moveCardFromBoard', 'moveCardToBoard', 'moveListFromBoard', 'moveListToBoard', 'removeChecklistFromCard', 'removeFromOrganizationBoard', 'removeMemberFromCard', 'unconfirmedBoardInvitation', 'unconfirmedOrganizationInvitation', 'updateBoard', 'updateCard', 'updateCard:closed', 'updateCard:desc', 'updateCard:idList', 'updateCard:name', 'updateCheckItemStateOnCard', 'updateChecklist', 'updateList', 'updateList:closed', 'updateList:name', 'updateMember', 'updateOrganization'.

idMember.description: The ID or username of the Trello member. Use 'me' to refer to the authenticated user. Defaults to 'me' if not provided.

memberships.description: Filters boards by the member's membership type. Accepts 'all' or a comma-separated list of: 'active', 'admin', 'deactivated', 'me', 'normal'.

organization.description: Determines whether to return organization data for boards. Valid values: 'true' or 'false'.

action_fields.description: Specifies fields for returned actions if actions are requested. Accepts 'all' or a comma-separated list: 'data', 'date', 'idMemberCreator', 'type'.

actions_limit.description: The maximum number of actions to return, from 0 to 1000.

actions_since.description: Filters actions to those that occurred after this date, or accepts 'null' or 'lastView'.

actions_format.description: The format for returned actions. Valid values: 'count', 'list', or 'minimal'.

actions_entities.description: Determines whether to return entity data for actions. Valid values: 'true' or 'false'.

organization_fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for the organization if 'organization' is 'true'. Accepts 'all' or a comma-separated list of field names. Possible field names: 'billableMemberCount', 'desc', 'descData', 'displayName', 'idBoards', 'invitations', 'invited', 'logoHash', 'memberships', 'name', 'powerUps', 'prefs', 'premiumFeatures', 'products', 'url', 'website'.

TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD.description: Retrieves lists from a specified Trello board, with options to filter lists and include card details.

cards.description: Determines which cards should be returned within the lists. Valid values are 'all', 'closed', 'none', or 'open'.

fields.description: Specifies the fields of the lists to be returned. Use 'all' for all fields, or provide a comma-separated list of specific fields. Valid fields include: closed, idBoard, name, pos, or subscribed.

filter.description: Filters the lists to be returned based on their status. Valid values are 'all', 'closed', 'none', or 'open'.

idBoard.description: The ID of the Trello board. Valid formats: 24-character hexadecimal ID (e.g., '60d5f2f1c8a8b4002b8f0123') OR 8-character shortLink (e.g., 'TH6F0pTM'). Human-readable board names or URL slugs (e.g., 'my-board', 'tech-jcorp') are NOT valid identifiers. In the URL 'trello.com/b/TH6F0pTM/my-board', 'TH6F0pTM' is the valid shortLink, while 'my-board' is just a slug and cannot be used. To find your board ID or shortLink: use TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_BOARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER to list your boards, or look at the board URL in your browser.

card_fields.description: Specifies the fields of cards to be returned if the 'cards' parameter is not 'none'. Use 'all' for all fields, or provide a comma-separated list of specific fields. Valid fields include: badges, checkItemStates, closed, dateLastActivity, desc, descData, due, email, idAttachmentCover, idBoard, idChecklists, idLabels, idList, idMembers, idMembersVoted, idShort, labels, manualCoverAttachment, name, pos, shortLink, shortUrl, subscribed, or url.

TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_ID_LIST_BY_ID_CARD.description: Moves a Trello card to a different list on the same Trello board; this operation is idempotent and only updates the card's list ID.

value.description: The ID of the target list to move the card to. Must be a valid, existing list ID (24-character hex string). The target list must be on the same board as the card.

idCard.description: The ID or short link of the card to be moved. Must be a valid, existing card ID. Card IDs can be short (e.g., `FY2OWrnc`) or long 24-character hex string (e.g., `571d07b591c8b68aeb4f6acc`).

TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD.description: Updates an existing Trello card's attributes like name, description, due date, members, labels, position, or archives/unarchives it, attaches files, or changes its cover.

due.description: The new due date for the card, in ISO 8601 format, or 'null' to remove the due date.

pos.description: The new position of the card within its list. Can be 'top', 'bottom', or a positive floating-point number. Higher numbers are further down the list.

desc.description: The new description for the card. String length must be from 0 to 16384 characters.

name.description: The new name for the card. Required if not copying the name from `idCardSource`, `fileSource`, or `urlSource`.

closed.description: Determines whether the card should be archived (closed). Accepts boolean (true/false) or string ('true'/'false').

idCard.description: The ID or shortLink of the card to update.

idList.description: The ID of the list to move the card to.

labels.description: Comma-separated list of label colors (e.g., 'green,yellow,red') to apply, overwriting existing labels. Use 'idLabels' for more precise control. 'all' may add all available label colors.

idBoard.description: The ID of the board to move the card to. If `idList` is also provided, the card will be moved to that list on the new board.

idLabels.description: Comma-separated list of label IDs to apply, replacing existing labels. To preserve existing labels, fetch current `idLabels`, append new ones, and submit the combined list.

idMembers.description: Comma-separated list of member IDs to assign, replacing existing members. To preserve existing members, fetch current `idMembers`, append new ones, and submit the combined list.

urlSource.description: A URL to be attached to the card (e.g., a link to an external resource). If the card is being created from a URL (e.g. via a bookmarklet), this will be the source URL. Set to 'null' or an empty string to remove an existing attachment link created this way.

fileSource.description: The URL of a file to be attached to the card. Trello will fetch and attach the file from this URL.

subscribed.description: Determines whether the user is subscribed to the card. Accepts boolean (true/false) or string ('true'/'false').

idCardSource.description: The ID of a card to copy properties from. Requires `keepFromSource` to be specified.

keepFromSource.description: If `idCardSource` is specified, this is a comma-separated list of properties to copy from the source card. Valid values are 'all', or any combination of 'attachments', 'checklists', 'comments', 'customFields', 'due', 'labels', 'members', 'pluginData', 'stickers'.

idAttachmentCover.description: The ID of an existing image attachment to be used as the card cover. Use 'null' or an empty string to remove the cover.

TRELLO_ADD_CARDS_ACTIONS_COMMENTS_BY_ID_.description: Adds a new text comment, which can include @mentions, to a Trello card specified by its ID; file attachments are not supported via this action.

examples: What's the status on this task? @username
text.description: Comment text, between 1 and 16384 characters. Supports @mentions to notify Trello users.

idCard.description: ID or shortLink of the Trello card to add the comment to.

TRELLO_GET_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD.description: Retrieves a Trello card by its ID or shortlink, with options to include related data like actions, attachments, members, and checklists.

list.description: Include data for the card's list. Use 'true' or 'false'.

board.description: Include data for the card's board. Use 'true' or 'false'.

fields.default: badges, checkItemStates, closed, dateLastActivity, desc, descData, due, email, idBoard, idChecklists, idLabels, idList, idMembers, idShort, idAttachmentCover, manualCoverAttachment, labels, name, pos, shortUrl and url
fields.description: Fields for the card: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'name,desc'). Valid: badges, checkItemStates, closed, dateLastActivity, desc, descData, due, email, idAttachmentCover, idBoard, idChecklists, idLabels, idList, idMembers, idMembersVoted, idShort, labels, manualCoverAttachment, name, pos, shortLink, shortUrl, subscribed, url.

idCard.description: The unique identifier or shortlink of the Trello card. Must be either a 24-character hexadecimal ID (e.g., '5abbe4b7ddc1b351ef961414') or an 8-character alphanumeric shortlink (e.g., 'H0TZyzbK'). Short numeric strings like '6514' are not valid.

actions.description: Actions to return: 'all' or a comma-separated list of types (e.g., 'addAttachmentToCard', 'commentCard', 'updateCard'). For a complete list of types, consult the Trello API documentation.

list_fields.description: Fields for the list: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'name,pos'). Valid: closed, idBoard, name, pos, subscribed.

board_fields.default: name, desc, descData, closed, idOrganization, pinned, url and prefs
board_fields.description: Fields for the board: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'name,desc'). Valid: closed, dateLastActivity, dateLastView, desc, descData, idOrganization, invitations, invited, labelNames, memberships, name, pinned, powerUps, prefs, shortLink, shortUrl, starred, subscribed, url.

membersVoted.description: Include data for members who voted. Use 'true' or 'false'.

action_fields.description: Fields for actions: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'data,date'). Valid: data, date, idMemberCreator, type.

member_fields.description: Fields for members: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'avatarHash,fullName'). Valid: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, username.

sticker_fields.description: Fields for stickers: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'image,left'). Valid: image, imageScaled, imageUrl, left, rotate, top, zIndex.

actions_display.description: Return display-friendly action data. Use 'true' or 'false'.

checkItemStates.description: Include check item states. Use 'true' or 'false'.

actions_entities.description: Include entities (e.g., card, board, member) for actions. Use 'true' or 'false'.

checklist_fields.description: Fields for checklists: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'idBoard,name'). Valid: idBoard, idCard, name, pos.

attachment_fields.description: Fields for attachments: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'bytes,date'). Valid: bytes, date, edgeColor, idMember, isUpload, mimeType, name, previews, url.

memberVoted_fields.description: Fields for members who voted: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'avatarHash,fullName'). Valid: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, username.

checkItemState_fields.description: Fields for check item states: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'idCheckItem,state'). Valid: idCheckItem, state.

action_memberCreator_fields.description: Fields for the action creator: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'avatarHash,fullName'). Valid: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, username.
